# Empty

What a region shows when it loaded and has nothing: why, and what to do next.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** No orders yet.

- **Use it when:** An empty list, a search with no results, or a first visit with no items yet.
- **Not when:** Still loading (skeleton or spinner), or a load that failed (alert).

Instead:

- [Skeleton](./skeleton.md): Still loading.
- [Alert](./alert.md): Something went wrong.

## How Multi-brand uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An empty state</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Shared structure, brand words</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A different structure per brand</div></div><div class="cap">The structure is the shared core; words carry the brand. Example: “No orders yet. Your first order will appear here.”</div></div></div>

## Why it works this way

Empty looks the way it does because of 3 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Empty, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-voice-definition"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How is the voice defined?</b><code>voice.definition</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">A shared core, brand tone on top</div><p>Errors and confirmations are shared; brand tone sits on top.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>default</b>: Shared structure in every brand: no brand pictures in empty states.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Alert: destructive</code> <code>Toast: neutral</code> <code>Toast: danger</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Empty decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-theming-definition"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How are brands handled?</b><code>theming.definition</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Brands as modes</div><p>Brands are theme modes over shared semantics.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>default</b>: Shared structure in every brand: no brand pictures in empty states.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Sidebar: default</code> <code>Sidebar: outline</code> <code>Item: muted</code> <code>Toggle: outline</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Empty decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-iconography-definition"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What icon style?</b><code>iconography.definition</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Outline</div><p>One outline set for every brand.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Empty</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>icon</b>: An icon in a small tile, from the one outline set every brand shares.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Input group: inline-start</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Empty decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add empty
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Empty reads 15 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Empty's tokens to change Empty alone.
